verdict.rationale: AgentMail provides event-driven building blocks for autonomous background agents. Webhooks push a POST on each new email so agents need not poll, WebSockets offer a persistent real-time event stream, and agents can self-register and create inboxes on demand via API. However, the evidence shows no hosted automation, rules, or scheduling feature, so the user must build and host the background agent logic themselves. Missing for 10: a native automation/rules or scheduled-job capability run by AgentMail, and hands-on corroboration of autonomous background workflows.
